slides.title: "Anyone going 6am?"
slides.body: Sent at 5:52am. From the car park.

slides.title: "Who's in Saturday?"
slides.body: Forty replies. Four people turn up. The same four as always.

slides.title: The PR video.
slides.body: Forty seconds long. The lift is the last two. Everyone replies "beast" anyway.

slides.title: "Is it scaled?"
slides.body: Asked about a workout nobody has seen yet. Coach is typing.

slides.title: "Who left their shoes?"
slides.body: Photo attached. Nobody claims them. They are still there.

slides.title: The silent one.
slides.body: Chat muted since 2024. Never misses a class.
